cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 64% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Refining & Downstream lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +6.85%; weakest is Refining & Downstream at -0.93%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +11.45%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +11.45%, BE +9.96%, TLN +9.44%, ETN +7.93%, ENPH +7.70%. Laggards: MPC -2.96%, MPLX -2.38%, FANG -1.86%, APA -1.70%.
